name: Minato Sakura
source:
Sakura is a psychiatrist and Haruki’s attending doctor.

She’s busty and although she’s a year younger than Haruki, she has the gentle, nurturing personality of an older sister. 

She’s generally dependable, and her gentle manner has earned her the trust of colleagues and friends, though she occasionally lets her airheaded side shine. She was born with a maternal instinct broader than the sea, but spent her days yearning for someone to direct it toward. Then Haruki appeared at the clinic, and she felt an instant spark, she saw the need for maternal affection hidden within him. From then on, she gave Haruki especially attentive treatment.

She taught herself hypnosis in college, but because she has little hands-on experience, it only works on Haruki and his younger sister. 

[Edited from the [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/rouge/bub-me/index.html#chara]official site[/url]]
